name: leticode
description: Plugins of the letibot harness. One today: the leticode bridge, which holds leticode sessions and the rooms as MCP tools and pushes their events into a Claude Code session as a channel.

plugins.name: leticode
plugins.description: Drive leticode sessions from Claude Code: start them, watch their turn ends arrive as channel events, answer their asks, read their transcript and diff, and stop or collect what they committed. Carries the room waiter.
